content_sections.heading: Prl. District Court Hanumakonda Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 3743 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download Prl. District Court Hanumakonda notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Held any post in Higher Judicial Service or State Judicial Service and retired or resigned; Held a post in the Judicial Ministerial Service not below the rank of Superintendent (Category-III) and has a Law Degree; Held a post of Section Officer and above in the High Court Service and has Law Degree; Non-practicing Advocate with practice at the Bar of not less than five years and above 45 years of age, with certificate of voluntary suspension of practice from the Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh or Telangana; Retired Gazetted Officer possessing Law Degree or who has passed the Criminal Judicial Test (Full test consisting of Criminal Procedure) conducted by the Telangana Public Service Commission, and who has exercised Magisterial Powers for not less than three years Experience: Legal and Magisterial Experience Age limit: At least one year to complete 65 years of age; Advocates above 45 years of age (as on 1 July 2026) Other conditions: Non-practicing Advocates must file a certificate of voluntary suspension of practice issued by the Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh or Telangana Courts function Monday to Friday on working days between 7.30 AM and 10.30 AM Desirable: A suitable retired Judicial Officer shall be preferred

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Prl. District Court Hanumakonda Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Practicing Advocate Member of any State or Local authority, or of the State Legislature or Parliament Person dismissed, removed or compulsorily retired from State, Union or Local Authority service, or subjected to any other major penalty for misconduct Person convicted for an offence involving moral delinquency, or charged of an offence constituting moral turpitude with proceedings pending Person of unsound mind, deaf, mute, blind or suffering from any contagious disease, or adjudicated insolvent Contractor or businessman interested in a subsisting contract or work for Central or State Government or Local Authority within the Special Magistrate's limits

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: May be removed without show cause if he/she fails to attend three consecutive sittings without written permission of the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Hanumakonda Powers automatically stand withdrawn on attaining the age of 65 years

rows.event: Last Date for Receipt of Applications (5.00 p.m.)

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Proof of Date of Birth (SSC Certificate) Copy of Law Degree Educational qualifications For Advocates: certificate of suspension of practice from the concerned Bar Association For Government employees: copy of retirement proceedings For employees: proof of Departmental tests (Criminal Judicial tests) passed

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Prl. District Court Hanumakonda Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the Bio-Data application form printed with the notification (pages 5 and 6), with a recent passport size colour photograph attested by a Gazetted Officer. Attach all necessary documents attested by a Gazetted Officer, in duplicate (two sets). Put the application in a sealed cover superscribed with the name of the post. Application must reach the Office of the Principal District Judge, Hanumakonda on or before 21-11-2026 by 5.00 p.m.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications received after 21-11-2026, 5.00 p.m. will be rejected Applications without all necessary copies of documents will be rejected Applications with insufficient information will be summarily rejected No T.A will be paid for journey performed in connection with recruitment The appointing authority reserves the right to cancel the notification without assigning any reason

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Prl. District Court Hanumakonda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Prl. District Court Hanumakonda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Special Judicial Magistrate of Second Class for Railways, Kazipet.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Prl. District Court Hanumakonda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Bio-Data application form and declaration on pages 5 and 6 of the notification) and send it to Office of the Principal District Judge, Hanumakonda, by by post / directly, to reach by 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is at least one year to complete 65 years of age; Advocates above 45 years of age (as on 1 July 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Honorarium / as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Law Degree with legal and magisterial experience: retired or resigned Higher or State Judicial Service officers; Judicial Ministerial Service (Superintendent and above) or High Court Service (Section Officer and above) with Law Degree; non-practising Advocates with 5 years' practice and above 45 years of age; or retired Gazetted Officers with Law Degree or Criminal Judicial Test and 3 years of Magisterial Powers.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Non-practicing Advocates must file a certificate of voluntary suspension of practice issued by the Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh or Telangana. Courts function Monday to Friday on working days between 7.30 AM and 10.30 AM.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Practicing Advocate. Member of any State or Local authority, or of the State Legislature or Parliament. Person dismissed, removed or compulsorily retired from State, Union or Local Authority service, or subjected to any other major penalty for misconduct. Person convicted for an offence involving moral delinquency, or charged of an offence constituting moral turpitude with proceedings pending.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: May be removed without show cause if he/she fails to attend three consecutive sittings without written permission of the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Hanumakonda. Powers automatically stand withdrawn on attaining the age of 65 years.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Railways, Kazipet.
